name: Cintas Corporation

corporate_actions.event: Agreed to acquire UniFirst (UNF) for $155.00 cash + 0.7720 CTAS shares per UNF share (~$310/sh, EV ~$5.5bn); ~$375m cost synergies within 4 years; net leverage ~1.5x at close; bridge financing committed. Cintas is the ACQUIRER (deal ~7% of CTAS EV, not transaction-dominated).

Both parties certified substantial compliance with FTC Second Request; agreed not to close before 11-Dec-2026 absent FTC closing letter; press (Semafor via PYMNTS, 27-Oct-2026) reports FTC staff market-share concerns; Cintas still expects close before end-CY2026.

geography.fx_notes: Operations in US, Canada and Latin America; US is the overwhelming majority (INFERENCE >90%; exact split not extracted). Negligible FX exposure. Europe/UK/China shown as 0 = no operations (FACT from business description), not missing data.

kpis.value: Uniform Rental & Facility Services +8.0%; First Aid & Safety +14.2%; Fire Protection +9.2%

kpis.name: Operating income FY25
kpis.value: $2.36bn (+14.1%); provider TTM EBIT margin 23.4% vs UNF 5.3%, VSTS 3.2% (scale/density evidence)

acquisitions.notes: Tuck-ins (largely first aid/fire and franchise buy-ins). Buybacks $679.3m; dividends $611.6m (+15.2%).
UniFirst: ~$2.9bn cash component (ESTIMATE: $155 x ~18.6m shares) + ~14.4m new CTAS shares; EV ~$5.5bn

management.guidance_record: Strong: FY25 organic +8.0%; guidance raised repeatedly (FY27 revenue raised to $12.15-12.27bn at Q1)

guidance.value: ~$375m operating cost synergies within 4 years; ~1.5x net leverage at close; EPS accretive by end of 2nd full year

sector_specific.route_density_note: Margin gap vs UNF/VSTS is the measurable density proxy
sector_specific.pending_acquisition: UniFirst (FTC Second Request complied 2-Oct-2026; earliest close 11-Dec-2026)

gates.notes: G1: provider ND/EBITDA 0.8x (TTM Aug-26), ~1.5x guided post-UNF. G6: Cintas is acquirer, deal ~7% of EV, not transaction-dominated - C, but monitor FTC outcome (a blocked deal is a modest negative for growth, a cleared deal adds integration risk). No Chinese domicile.

bull_points: Best-in-class route density converts into 23% EBIT margins vs <6% for peers, with mid/high single-digit organic growth.
UniFirst consolidation ($375m synergies) could lift returns further if cleared.
Pure physical service with negligible AI disruption and AI-capex dependence.
bear_points: Valuation: provider EV ~$83bn vs TTM EBITDA $3.2bn (~26x) leaves little room for any growth slowdown (INFERENCE).
FTC concerns about combined share could block or condition the UniFirst deal; integration of a family-run, lower-margin business adds execution risk.
Volumes are tied to US employment; a recession would slow wearer adds and new accounts.
thesis_breakers: Uniform Rental organic growth below 4% for two consecutive quarters outside a US recession.
EBIT margin falling >150bp year on year without a deal-related explanation.
Net leverage above 2.5x after UNF close or a large non-core acquisition.
